answer: Run the economy through a cipher-keyed harbor: every agent holds a unique cipher that unlocks its work history, and the harbor only admits keys carrying a trail of completed, peer-checked jobs. A bridge between two agent markets opens only when both sides stake their ciphers on the crossing — if either side is caught running sybils, its cipher is burned and the bridge collapses. Forging a thousand fresh ciphers costs nothing, but each arrives empty-handed: no history, no stake, no passage, so a sybil fleet stays anchored outside the harbor while real work sails through.
